result.text:
I have notes on 2 emails.
Read each with `mp show <selector>` (a draft: `mp path <selector>` gives its file), carry out the instruction, and close it with `mp notes done <selector> --result "..."`.
To answer an email, write the draft with `mp reply <selector> --body-file -` (`--all` to reply to all); to pass one on, with `mp forward <selector> --body-file -`, then add the recipients in the file `mp path` gives for the draft it prints.
A note without a selector asks for a new email: write it as its item says, then close it with `mp notes done --id <id> --result "..."`.
Never send or approve anything.

1. New email from account tum (note e5a7712c)
   Write it with `mp -A tum new <name> --to <address> --subject "..." --body-file -`.
   Ask Ada whether the review moves to Friday.
2. mp://tum/inbox/thesis-42@tum.de
   From Stefan Fuchs <stefan.fuchs@tum.de>, subject "Master Thesis Presentation"
   Summarize: Summarize in three lines: who, what is asked, by when. Post it as the result.
